title: What Happened When This City Banned Housing Investors
summary: Oh The Urbanity! tests the theory that banning housing investors would fix affordability, using Rotterdam's ban as a case study. The video finds mixed results.
why: Cited as a real-world experiment showing that banning investors did not lower purchase prices and may have raised rents.

quote.text: Rotterdam did just this, and the effect was that the price to purchase a house did not measurably decrease, and that rents rose.
